call_points.text: Bridal jewellery is expected to generate approximately one-third of total revenue within the current year.
Sharp increase in Q4 other expenses was driven primarily by notional losses from gold hedging on MCX.
Total hedging ratio stands at ~60%: 30% barter exchange (advance gold), 17% GML, and 13% MCX.
Commercial production from new capacity resumed 23 Feb 2026 at 57% utilization.
The company entered the bridal jewellery segment to address high wedding spend.
Gross margin expanded 141 bps YoY to 9.4% in FY26 from 8.0% in FY25.
Net cash from operating activities stood at negative ₹281.7 Cr in FY26 due to working capital additions.
Inventories expanded to ₹439.4 Cr as of FY26 compared to ₹228.1 Cr in FY25.
About 30% of bullion requirements are fulfilled via the Advanced Gold Model.
